articles.summaryOriginal: The nomination of Kim Ji-yong as the first head of the Serious Crimes Investigation Agency has intensified debate within the ruling camp over whether the new body could produce another politically influential prosecutor. Critics question Kim’s 24-year prosecutorial career and past positions on prosecution reform, while President Lee Jae Myung supports allowing his nomination to proceed. The National Assembly’s Public Administration and Security Committee is expected to hold a confirmation hearing in the coming weeks. Kim Ji-yong, nominee for the inaugural head of the Serious Crimes Investigation Agency, arrives at the agency’s launch-preparation office in Seoul, Friday. Newsis

articles.titleOriginal: Vance says US, S. Korea still need to 'work out' details of Alaska gas project
articles.titleJa: Vance氏は、米国、韓国はまだアラスカのガスプロジェクトの詳細を「解決」する必要があると述べている
articles.summaryJa: 米国のバンス副大統領は月曜日にワシントンで、米国と韓国はまだ提案されているアラスカ液化天然ガスプロジェクトの詳細を策定する必要があると述べた。彼は、アメリカの天然ガスに対するアジアの強い需要を引き合いに出して、パイプラインが前進すると確信していると述べた。
articles.summaryOriginal: U.S. Vice President JD Vance said Monday in Washington that the United States and South Korea still need to work out details of a proposed Alaska liquefied natural gas project. He expressed confidence that the pipeline will move forward, citing strong Asian demand for American natural gas. South Korea’s industry ministry said the project has not been finalized and requires reviews of commercial viability and other factors before an investment decision. U.S. Vice President JD Vance speaks during a campaign rally in support of Republican gubernatorial candidate Byron Donalds in Lakeland, Florida, on Oct. 1. AFP-Yonhap

articles.titleOriginal: Chief justice calls presidential intervention in Supreme Court nominations unconstitutional
articles.titleJa: 最高裁判所長官は、最高裁判所の指名に対する大統領の介入を違憲と呼ぶ
articles.summaryJa: 最高裁判所のチョ・ヒデ最高裁判所長官は火曜日にソウルで、イ・ジェミョン大統領は最高裁判所判事候補者の推薦に介入する憲法上の権限を持っていないと述べた。議会の監査中にチョー氏は、チェン・ワデ氏の別の候補者への要求を拒否し、大統領の介入は権力分立と司法の独立を損なうと述べた。
articles.summaryOriginal: Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae said Tuesday in Seoul that President Lee Jae Myung has no constitutional authority to intervene in his recommendation of Supreme Court justice candidates. Speaking during a parliamentary audit, Cho rejected Cheong Wa Dae’s demand for another nominee and said presidential intervention would undermine the separation of powers and judicial independence. The dispute has left one Supreme Court seat vacant for more than seven months. Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae speaks during a parliamentary audit of the Supreme Court at the National Assembly in Seoul, Tuesday. Yonhap

articles.titleOriginal: Interview 'China has never asked Seoul to choose a side between Beijing, Washington,' envoy says
articles.titleJa: インタビュー「中国はソウルに北京とワシントンのどちらか一方を選ぶよう要請したことは一度もない」と特使は述べている
articles.summaryJa: 9月29日、駐韓中国大使のダイビン氏はソウルで、中国が韓国に北京とワシントンのどちらかを選ぶよう要請したことは一度もないと述べた。彼は、韓国は米国との同盟を放棄することなく戦略的自治を追求しながら、両国との関係を維持すべきだと述べた。
articles.summaryOriginal: Chinese Ambassador to Korea Dai Bing said in Seoul on Sept. 29 that China has never asked Korea to choose between Beijing and Washington. He said Korea should maintain relations with both countries while pursuing strategic autonomy without abandoning its U.S. alliance. Dai described Korea-China economic cooperation as shifting toward quality, resilience and horizontal integration, with potential in advanced industries and supply chains. He also called for dialogue on the Korean Peninsula and expanded people-to-people exchanges. Chinese Ambassador to Korea Dai Bing speaks during an interview with The Korea Times at the Chinese Embassy in Myeong-dong, Jung District, Seoul, Sept. 29. Korea Times photo by Shim Hyun-chul
